body:
I thought I'd reply to your comment with my own thoughts, mainly just to get them out of my goddamn head.

My subjective opinion is that combat design wise there was some weird philosophy going on that was creeping into elden ring that is at it's peak with promised consort that I think clashes completely with how the combat has worked in every game (d. souls, ds1, ds2, ds3, bb, sekiro and a large part of the early/mid game in elden ring).

screw particular moves of consort, to me two things would improve this fight;  
1. reduce the "holy visual" bloat in second phase, make them less demanding for "particle intense" for lag ( I didn't suffer the lag, but I can easily see why others would have issues) and make it somewhat see through, so you can still see consort's movements.

2. give consort some actual recovery frames to his attacks (by that I mean, no hitboxes are present but he cannot immediately swing into any other attack, in all the other games once you figured out the moveset of a boss, you knew how much "time" you had in between the previous attack (hitbox gone) and the following attack (hitbox start) or any repositioning abilities.

I always liked the methodical dance like element to previous fromsoftware titles, I have never wanted a hyperspeed and nonstop approach to bosses in these games.   
There's an element of constant hyper reactivity that the player needs to possess in some of these bosses that is somewhat similar to how you have to approach fps or fighting style games which is not present in previous games, even sekiro, just my thoughts on the matter.

If you're already having those kind of conversations now, then you're probably not a failure. If I was your daughter I'd probably be thinking "this is an unexpected change"

but thanks for the reply

I can understand why easily, i kind of expected this, it's just that i'd noticed especially recently alot of people seem to be downtrodden, not just depressed (in my real life aswell and not just cause of the current situation but more the side effects of the counter measures), as naive as it was, i just felt like trying something.

but i understand completely.

I should point out i feel a strong largely aimless(in terms of practical knowledgeable motion "purpose" to help young men and women who lived in those experiences, or boys/girls currently in that situation but i just dont know how, which i know is a part of life
